His own clinic sites and LinkedIn are self-published and were NOT counted toward the band. CONTACTS - all three passed the mandatory exact-phrase re-check and all belong to HIS OWN institution, not an aggregator: 'enquiry@asianentcarecentre.com' returned multiple real indexed pages on asianentcarecentre.com (Contact Us, Services, Tinnitus Management, BERA, VEMP) plus the centre's official Facebook page; '8008188800' returned the centre's own contact-us page, its Facebook page and its Practo/Medindia/IndiaMART clinic listings; '8179033446' returned the centre's contact-us page, doctors page and its own blog. Because he is Chairman of that centre, its published reception line and enquiry mailbox are the legitimate professional route to him, and the appointment line is recorded as secretary_number. EXPLICITLY REJECTED: 04069321004, which two search summaries offered as 'his' number - it is Apollo's central switchboard and is not any individual doctor's line; the JustDial listings (call-tracking proxies); the HexaHealth aggregator helpline; and a RocketReach page that surfaced, which is a barred contact-broker source. Also note the input row lists 'Apollo Cradle Jubilee Hills / Apollo Health City'; Apollo's own page places him at Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills, which is consistent. Two LinkedIn profiles exist for him ('dr-chava-anjaneyulu-ent-surgeon' and 'anjaneyulu-chava-5bb35620'), both naming Asian ENT Care Centre; the first is recorded as primary and the second noted, and a human may wish to confirm which is actively used.
